A '''diamond axe''' is an [[Tools#Axe|axe]] of the [[Diamond equipment|diamond]] tier, crafted from three [[diamond]]s and two sticks.

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Woodcutting ===
It breaks axe blocks at speed 9 and has 2500 durability. Matcha Flavoured adds beds, candles, cacti and honeycomb blocks to the blocks that axes break quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|9}} damage at an attack speed of 1, the same damage as the iron axe but a faster swing.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[diamond]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one diamond. It is the base for both [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] and [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] upgrades. With a [[smithing upgrade template]] it becomes an [[Electrum Dolabra|electrum]] or [[adamant dolabra]].
